text:
olivia: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands 1 security/privacy thread 1 SOC2, ISO, VPC/BYOK, audit logs. Panel: @mari, @raj, @jeff. Drop short Qs here and we'll answer. :lock:

kim: SOC2 Type II  can we give customers an ETA to cite?

mari: Target remains Q4 2025. Auditor fieldwork planned for an 8-week window in Oct/Nov; final report expected late Q4. Scope: Hosted API + Redwood-managed Dedicated.

kim: For Private/on-prem customers  will they get a letter or any artifacts?

mari: We provide an evidence bundle and an attestation letter on request. Private deployments have shared controls with customers, so we give them the docs they need to present in their audits.

jeff: ISO27001 status?

raj: ISO is planned next program cycle (early 2026 kickoff). We'll map SOC2 controls to speed certification. No auditor booked yet.

kim: BYOK details  can customers rotate keys without downtime?

mari: Yes. BYOK via cross-account KMS is supported. We recommend envelope encryption and coordinating rotations if you have long-lived sessions. Rotations are transparent if you use GenerateDataKey without re-encrypting active caches.

kim: minimal KMS grant snippet?

mari: Example snippet (simplified):

```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Sid":"AllowRedwood","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodKMSAccess"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"*"}]}
```

olivia: Audit logs  retention defaults and export formats?

mari: Hosted default: 365 days (extendable). Dedicated: 365 included, long-term archival add-on available. Private: customer controlled. Exports: ndjson/parquet to S3 or direct stream to SIEMs.

jeff: Fields included: request_id, customer_id (masked for public exports), model, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, latency_ms, region, route, decision_reason. We also emit a salted prompt fingerprint for regression tracking (not reversible).

kim: PII redaction before export?

mari: Optional pipeline stage supports deterministic hashing, pattern redaction, and custom rules. We recommend enabling redaction for regulated workloads.

security-bot: Reminder: evidence owners, upload remaining artifacts by 2025-09-30 to the evidence portal: https://portal.redwood.com/evidence. :rotating_light:

raj: Action items: we'll publish a "Security Starter Pack" next week with control mappings, BYOK cookbook, VPC checklist, and audit-log schema. Link will be posted here.

olivia: Thanks all. If you have customer-specific asks, DM the account lead and cc @mari. :thumbsup:
